2118762700515983749.en_summary: $MSFT is reportedly winding down older $NVDA capacity rented from $ORCL as it reviews billions in cloud deals, but this looks more like a shift toward newer GPUs than a retreat from AI spending. Microsoft asked $IREN to upgrade its GB300 network for frontier models while IREN re-contracted older H100s at double their original price, suggesting AI demand is shifting across GPU generations.
